metadata.title: CDN Providers Directory & Bandwidth Cost Dataset (2026)

providers.name: Cloudflare CDN
providers.free_tier: Unlimited unmetered HTML/CSS/JS bandwidth forever (Free Plan); Pro $20/mo, Business $200/mo
providers.restrictions: Free/Pro plans prohibit serving disproportionate raw video, audio, or S3 binary archives unless using Cloudflare R2, Stream, or Images (ToS Service-Specific Terms).
providers.best_for: Websites, SaaS apps, APIs, DDoS protection, and zero-egress R2 object storage

providers.name: Bunny.net (Standard Network)
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial (1,000 GB bandwidth, no credit card required)
providers.restrictions: $1.00/month minimum account spend; requires $10 minimum balance top-up after 14-day free trial.
providers.best_for: Low-latency global static assets, game patches, WordPress, and predictable pay-as-you-go billing

providers.name: Bunny.net (Volume Network)
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial (1,000 GB bandwidth, no credit card required)
providers.restrictions: Uses 12 high-capacity regional PoPs instead of 123 edge PoPs; optimized for throughput over ultra-low millisecond edge proximity.
providers.best_for: Video VOD, software downloads, Linux ISOs, podcasts, and high-bandwidth media ($0.002–$0.005/GB)

providers.name: Amazon CloudFront (AWS)
providers.free_tier: Always Free: 1 TB data transfer out + 10,000,000 HTTP/HTTPS requests + 2M CloudFront Function invocations per month
providers.restrictions: High list price ($0.085/GB after 1 TB) unless you commit to a 12-month CloudFront Security Savings Bundle or custom enterprise contract; charges $0.0075–$0.01 per 10k HTTPS requests.
providers.best_for: AWS S3/EC2 workloads under 1 TB/month (100% free) or enterprise AWS committed contracts

providers.name: Gcore CDN
providers.free_tier: Always Free Plan: 1 TB monthly traffic + 1,000,000 requests/month + Free DDoS Protection
providers.restrictions: Free plan caps at 1 TB/month and 1M requests/month; overage requires upgrading to a paid tier starting at $35/mo.
providers.best_for: Gaming, live low-latency streaming, emerging markets (LATAM/CIS/Asia), and 1 TB free projects

providers.name: Fastly CDN
providers.free_tier: Free Developer Plan: Up to $50/month in free bandwidth and request usage forever
providers.restrictions: High pay-as-you-go bandwidth ($0.12/GB NA/EU) plus $0.0075–$0.016 per 10,000 requests once you exceed the $50/mo free developer credit.
providers.best_for: Dynamic APIs, e-commerce, news publishers needing <150ms surrogate-key cache invalidation, and Rust/Wasm edge apps

providers.name: KeyCDN
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial (25 GB free traffic, no credit card required)
providers.restrictions: $4/month minimum usage fee; initial credit purchase minimum is $49 (credits roll over for 12 months).
providers.best_for: Simple flat-rate global pricing ($0.04/GB across all continents for first 10 TB) and WordPress/CMS acceleration

providers.name: CDN77
providers.free_tier: 30-day Free Trial with 500 GB–1 TB test quota
providers.restrictions: Entry plans start at ~$199/month for 6–15 TB bundled traffic; designed for medium-to-high bandwidth workloads rather than hobby sites.
providers.best_for: High-volume OTT video streaming, live sports, VOD platforms, and 50 TB–10 PB+ monthly commits

providers.name: Google Cloud CDN
providers.pops: 200+ Google Edge Points of Presence (Jupiter backbone)
providers.free_tier: $300 Free GCP Trial Credit for new accounts (valid for 90 days)
providers.restrictions: Charges separately for cache egress ($0.02–$0.08/GB), cache fill (origin-to-cache transfer), and HTTP/HTTPS cache lookup requests ($0.0075 per 10k).
providers.best_for: Applications already running on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Google Cloud Storage

providers.name: Microsoft Azure Front Door (Azure CDN)
providers.free_tier: $200 Free Azure Credit (30 days)
providers.restrictions: Azure CDN Classic (Edgio/Verizon) was retired; Azure Front Door Standard has a $35/month base fee plus $0.081/GB egress and $0.01/10k request charges.
providers.best_for: Enterprise .NET/Azure workloads requiring Private Link origin security and integrated Azure WAF

providers.name: DigitalOcean Spaces CDN
providers.free_tier: $200 Free Cloud Credit (60 days) + 1 TB outbound transfer included in $5/mo plan
providers.restrictions: Starts at $5/month (includes 250 GiB S3 storage + 1 TiB outbound CDN bandwidth); overage is a flat $0.01/GiB globally with zero per-request fees.
providers.best_for: Developers needing S3 object storage + global CDN bundled at $5/mo (1 TB included) and flat $0.01/GB overage

providers.name: Cloudflare R2 + CDN
providers.free_tier: Always Free: 10 GB storage + 1M Class A + 10M Class B operations/mo + Unlimited Free Egress
providers.restrictions: Storage costs $0.015/GB-month after 10 GB free; uncached Class B reads cost $0.36 per million (cached edge hits are 100% free).
providers.best_for: Eliminating AWS S3/CloudFront egress bills — 100% legal on Cloudflare for large files, downloads, and media

providers.name: Akamai Connected Cloud (Ion / Delivery)
providers.free_tier: $100 Free Cloud Computing Credit (Linode/Akamai Cloud)
providers.restrictions: Full Akamai Ion CDN requires enterprise sales contracts; self-serve Object Storage CDN via Akamai Cloud (Linode) includes 1 TB/mo for $5/mo ($0.005/GB overage).
providers.best_for: Fortune 500 enterprises, banks, global media broadcasters, and deep ISP-level edge reach

providers.name: CacheFly
providers.free_tier: Free 5 TB/month trial or custom POC for high-volume senders
providers.restrictions: Focused on commercial and high-traffic customers (>10 TB/month); entry packages start around $295/mo.
providers.best_for: Game patch distribution, sub-second live streaming, and high-throughput TCP Anycast delivery

providers.name: CDNetworks
providers.pops: 2,800+ Global PoPs (Strongest APAC, China & Emerging Markets)
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial upon enterprise verification
providers.restrictions: Custom quote required for Mainland China cross-border acceleration (ICP filing support).
providers.best_for: Cross-border delivery into Mainland China, Southeast Asia, Korea, Japan, and Middle East

providers.name: CDNsun
providers.free_tier: 15-day Free Trial (50 GB free traffic, no credit card required)
providers.restrictions: Higher rates in Asia/Australia ($0.05/GB) compared to North America/Europe ($0.02/GB).
providers.best_for: Simple European and North American pay-as-you-go static and video hosting without monthly minimums

providers.name: BlazingCDN
providers.free_tier: Free Trial Credit ($5 test balance upon registration)
providers.restrictions: $5/month minimum spend; smaller PoP footprint in South America and Africa than Bunny.net or Cloudflare.
providers.best_for: Ultra-low-cost $5/TB bandwidth in Europe and North America

providers.name: Medianova CDN
providers.pops: 50+ PoPs (Strongest in MENA, Turkey, Eastern Europe & EU)
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial (100 GB bandwidth)
providers.restrictions: Starter plans begin at $49/month.
providers.best_for: E-commerce, gaming, and OTT streaming targeting MENA, Turkey, and Europe

providers.name: Imperva CDN (formerly Incapsula)
providers.pops: 62+ Resilient Security & DDoS Scrubbing PoPs (15+ Tbps)
providers.free_tier: Free Trial available for Enterprise Application Security + CDN
providers.restrictions: Incapsula's legacy free plan was discontinued; Imperva is now bundled as an enterprise WAAP (Web App & API Protection) suite.
providers.best_for: Regulated financial, healthcare, and enterprise applications prioritizing WAF and bot mitigation

providers.name: QUIC.cloud (LiteSpeed WordPress CDN)
providers.pops: 85+ Global PoPs with full dynamic WordPress HTML caching
providers.free_tier: Always Free Quota: Up to 10–20 GB/mo (LiteSpeed server users) + Free Image Optimization & Critical CSS
providers.restrictions: Full free tier benefits require running LiteSpeed Web Server or OpenLiteSpeed with the LiteSpeed Cache WordPress plugin.
providers.best_for: WordPress & WooCommerce sites running on LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed hosts (like Hostinger or Cloudways)

providers.name: ImageKit.io
providers.pops: 600+ Edge PoPs (Powered by AWS CloudFront + Real-Time Processing)
providers.free_tier: Always Free Plan: 20 GB monthly bandwidth + Unlimited image transformations + 20 GB media storage
providers.restrictions: Free plan caps at 20 GB bandwidth/month; Pro plan starts at $49–$89/mo with overage billed per 20 GB or 100 GB pack.
providers.best_for: Real-time URL image resizing, automatic WebP/AVIF conversion, and e-commerce product catalogs

providers.name: Cloudinary
providers.free_tier: Always Free Plan: 25 Monthly Credits (~25 GB bandwidth OR 25,000 transformations OR 25 GB storage)
providers.restrictions: Uses a unified Credit system (1 Credit = 1 GB bandwidth OR 1,000 transformations); Plus plan is $89/mo (225 credits), Advanced $224/mo (600 credits).
providers.best_for: Rich media pipelines, AI image/video transformations, and automatic Multi-CDN routing

providers.name: Imgix
providers.pops: Fastly Global Edge Network + Custom Image Rendering Cluster
providers.free_tier: Free Trial (1,000 Origin Images)
providers.restrictions: Billed by unique Origin Images + Bandwidth quota; Starter tier begins at $75/month.
providers.best_for: High-resolution photography, publishing, and on-the-fly URL image rendering from S3/GCS buckets

providers.name: Sirv Media CDN
providers.free_tier: Free Plan: 500 MB storage + 2 GB/month CDN transfer (with watermark on 360 spins)
providers.restrictions: Free plan has 500 MB storage limit; Business plans start at $19/mo for 5 GB storage and 20 GB transfer.
providers.best_for: E-commerce stores needing 360-degree interactive product viewers and zoomable images

providers.name: jsDelivr
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Forever for Open-Source npm & GitHub packages (Unlimited traffic within fair use)
providers.restrictions: Only serves public npm packages, GitHub release/repo files (<50 MB per file), and WordPress plugins; cannot be used as a private origin pull CDN.
providers.best_for: Serving open-source JS/CSS libraries, npm packages, and public GitHub assets in production with Multi-CDN failover

providers.name: cdnjs (Cloudflare Open-Source CDN)
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Forever (Unmetered bandwidth for 4,500+ curated open-source libraries)
providers.restrictions: Only hosts curated libraries approved in the cdnjs GitHub repository; arbitrary npm or GitHub files require jsDelivr or unpkg.
providers.best_for: Loading standard frontend libraries (Three.js, GSAP, Chart.js, FontAwesome) with Subresource Integrity (SRI)

providers.name: UNPKG
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Forever for any file published to the npm registry
providers.restrictions: Single-CDN architecture (no Multi-CDN failover like jsDelivr); strictly mirrors npm registry packages.
providers.best_for: Quick prototyping, CodePen/JSFiddle demos, and loading any file directly from npm

providers.name: esm.sh (Modern ES Module CDN)
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Forever for open-source ES Modules from npm &jsr
providers.restrictions: Designed for ES module `import` statements and import maps rather than legacy `<script>` global tags.
providers.best_for: Buildless React/Vue/Preact apps, Deno projects, and native browser Import Maps

providers.name: Google Hosted Libraries
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Forever (Google infrastructure)
providers.restrictions: Only hosts ~20 core libraries (jQuery, AngularJS, D3.js, Three.js, WebFont Loader); blocked in Mainland China.
providers.best_for: jQuery, Google Fonts, and core Google-hosted JS libraries outside Mainland China

providers.name: Statically.io
providers.free_tier: 100% Free for open-source GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket & WordPress SVN assets
providers.restrictions: For public Git repositories and open-source projects only.
providers.best_for: Replacing defunct RawGit to serve files directly from GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket repositories

providers.name: OVHcloud CDN
providers.pops: 40+ Global PoPs (100+ Tbps European & North American backbone)
providers.free_tier: Included with select OVHcloud Hosting or $11/mo base + unmetered traffic options
providers.restrictions: Best integrated with OVHcloud Public Cloud S3 or OVH Dedicated Servers.
providers.best_for: European GDPR-compliant workloads and OVHcloud server/storage customers

providers.name: Scaleway Edge Services
providers.free_tier: 75 GB Free Object Storage Egress/month
providers.restrictions: Pipeline base fee applies per configured Load Balancer / Bucket endpoint.
providers.best_for: EU sovereign cloud architectures on Scaleway S3 Object Storage and Kapsule Kubernetes

providers.name: Hetzner Object Storage + Cloudflare (Zero-Egress Stack)
providers.free_tier: 1 TB Outbound Traffic included in €4.99 (~$5.39/mo) base plan
providers.restrictions: Hetzner S3 charges only ~€1.00/TB ($0.001/GB) for egress; pair with Bunny.net or Cloudflare Cache for global edge caching.
providers.best_for: Lowest raw bandwidth cost in the industry ($1/TB origin egress) for self-managed CDN architectures

providers.name: Backblaze B2 + Cloudflare / Bunny.net (Bandwidth Alliance)
providers.pops: Backblaze S3 + Cloudflare (330+ PoPs) or Bunny.net (123+ PoPs)
providers.free_tier: First 10 GB B2 Storage Free Forever + 3x Storage Free Egress + $0 Egress to Cloudflare/Bunny/Fastly
providers.restrictions: Egress from Backblaze B2 to Cloudflare, Fastly, and Bunny.net is 100% free ($0.00/GB) under the Bandwidth Alliance; you only pay $6/TB/month for stored data.
providers.best_for: Hosting terabytes of assets on $6/TB S3 storage with $0.00/GB origin egress to Cloudflare or Bunny.net

providers.name: Bunny Stream (Video CDN + Transcoding)
providers.pops: 123+ Edge PoPs + Multi-Region NVMe Video Storage
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial (Free HLS transcoding & customizable HTML5 player)
providers.restrictions: Requires $1/month minimum spend; storage is $0.01/GB per replication region.
providers.best_for: Replacing expensive Vimeo/Wistia/Mux bills — free MP4-to-HLS transcoding and $0.005/GB video delivery

providers.name: Cloudflare Stream
providers.free_tier: Included in Creator bundles or $5/mo per 1,000 mins stored
providers.restrictions: Billed per minute ($5 per 1,000 minutes stored + $1 per 1,000 minutes delivered) regardless of 720p vs 1080p bitrate.
providers.best_for: Predictable per-minute video billing without worrying about 1080p/4K bandwidth spikes

providers.name: Mux Video CDN
providers.pops: Multi-CDN Automatic QoE Routing (Fastly + CloudFront + Akamai)
providers.free_tier: $20 Free Credit + 100,000 Free Encoded Minutes/month (Starter Promo)
providers.restrictions: Billed per minute of video delivered (~$0.0009/min at 1080p) plus storage ($0.003/min/mo).
providers.best_for: Developer-first video APIs requiring instant Multi-CDN failover and real-time QoE telemetry

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud CDN
providers.pops: 3,200+ Global PoPs (2,300+ in Mainland China + 900+ International)
providers.free_tier: Free Trial Package (50 GB–100 GB for new verified accounts)
providers.restrictions: Delivering via Mainland China PoPs requires a valid Chinese ICP Filing (ICP Beian); Near-China (Hong Kong/Singapore) requires no ICP.
providers.best_for: Delivering apps and e-commerce into Mainland China and Southeast Asia

providers.name: Tencent Cloud EdgeOne
providers.free_tier: Free Trial / Starter Plan from $9.90/month
providers.restrictions: Mainland China nodes require ICP license; Global (Excl. Mainland China) plan works immediately without ICP.
providers.best_for: Multiplayer gaming (TCP/UDP acceleration) and APAC + Global web security

providers.name: Oracle Cloud (OCI) 10 TB Free Outbound + Akamai CDN
providers.pops: 48 OCI Cloud Regions + Akamai CDN Interconnect
providers.free_tier: Always Free: First 10 TB/month of Outbound Data Transfer is $0.00/month in every OCI region
providers.restrictions: Requires credit card verification at signup; OCI native egress includes 10 TB/mo free — pair with Cloudflare or Caddy for global edge caching.
providers.best_for: Serving up to 10 TB/month of video, downloads, or API traffic at $0.00/month

providers.name: Vercel Edge Network
providers.free_tier: Hobby Free Plan: 100 GB Fast Data Transfer/month + 1,000,000 Edge Requests/month
providers.restrictions: Hobby Free plan is strictly for non-commercial use; Pro ($20/mo) includes 1 TB transfer, then charges $0.15/GB overage.
providers.best_for: Next.js and React apps under 1 TB/month (put Bunny.net or Cloudflare R2 in front for large media)

providers.name: Netlify Edge CDN
providers.pops: 100+ Global Edge PoPs (Powered by Fastly & Multi-Cloud)
providers.free_tier: Starter Free Plan: 100 GB bandwidth/month + 300 build minutes/month (Commercial use allowed)
providers.restrictions: Severe bandwidth overage trap ($55 per 100 GB = $0.55/GB!) once you exceed the 100 GB Starter or 1 TB Pro quota.
providers.best_for: Jamstack static websites under 100 GB/month (avoid serving heavy video/downloads directly from Netlify)

providers.name: Cloudflare Pages Edge CDN
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Unlimited Static Bandwidth & Unlimited Requests (Commercial use allowed)
providers.restrictions: Maximum 25 MB per individual static file and 20,000 files per deployment on the Free plan.
providers.best_for: Hosting static websites, docs, and frontend SPAs with zero risk of viral traffic bandwidth bills

providers.name: NOC.org Anycast CDN & WAF
providers.free_tier: 14-day Free Trial
providers.restrictions: Created by former Sucuri founders; focuses on security + website caching rather than raw multi-terabyte video VOD.
providers.best_for: Small businesses wanting flat $5/mo website WAF + Anycast CDN protection

providers.name: Sucuri Firewall & Anycast CDN (GoDaddy)
providers.free_tier: 30-day Money-Back Guarantee
providers.restrictions: Billed per website domain ($199.99/yr Basic or $9.99/mo WAF+CDN) rather than pure per-GB object storage CDN.
providers.best_for: WordPress, Magento, and Joomla sites needing managed WAF + malware removal SLA + CDN

providers.name: Jetpack Site Accelerator (formerly Photon by Automattic)
providers.free_tier: 100% Free Unlimited Image (WebP) & Static JS/CSS CDN for WordPress sites
providers.restrictions: Only caches WordPress images (`i0.wp.com`) and core/plugin static assets; cannot purge individual image URLs without renaming the file; VideoPress requires paid plan after 1st video.
providers.best_for: Zero-cost image and static asset offloading on self-hosted WordPress blogs

legacy_graveyard.what_happened: MaxCDN (consumer brand of NetDNA) was acquired by StackPath in 2016. StackPath shut down its public CDN in November 2023 and entered liquidation in June 2024.
StackPath merged Highwinds and MaxCDN, then abruptly terminated all CDN services in late 2023 before liquidating in 2024.

legacy_graveyard.status: Shut Down (Chapter 11 Bankruptcy — Network Turned Off Jan 2025)
legacy_graveyard.what_happened: Limelight Networks acquired Yahoo's EdgeCast in 2022 and rebranded to Edgio. Edgio filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Sept 2024; Akamai acquired select customer contracts and the Edgio CDN network was decommissioned in Jan 2025.
legacy_graveyard.recommended_migration: Akamai Connected Cloud, Fastly, or CDN77

legacy_graveyard.legacy_name: Microsoft Azure CDN from Edgio / Verizon
legacy_graveyard.what_happened: Because Edgio shut down its network, Microsoft retired Azure CDN Standard/Premium from Edgio (formerly Verizon) and migrated customers to Azure Front Door.
Incapsula was acquired by Imperva (now Thales). The free Incapsula CDN plan listed in older GitHub gists was discontinued years ago.
legacy_graveyard.recommended_migration: Cloudflare Free Plan or Gcore Free Tier (1 TB/mo)

legacy_graveyard.what_happened: Originally sponsored by MaxCDN/StackPath, BootstrapCDN was officially merged into jsDelivr (`cdn.jsdelivr.net`).
Academic peer-to-peer CDN running on PlanetLab (`.nyud.net`) shut down in 2015.
Shut down due to abusive traffic volume.
Google deprecated the proxy-based PageSpeed Service CDN in 2015 in favor of Google Cloud CDN.
Cotendo and Speedera were acquired by Akamai; Level 3 merged into Lumen (which sold select EMEA CDN assets); BitGravity was folded into Tata Communications.
Legacy OpenStack Swift wrapper at $0.12/GB — 12x more expensive than modern object storage CDNs.
legacy_graveyard.recommended_migration: Cloudflare R2 ($0.00/GB egress) or DigitalOcean Spaces ($5/mo for 1 TB)

legacy_graveyard.legacy_name: Usesos / Baidu Public Libs / SinaApp Public CDN
legacy_graveyard.what_happened: 360 Usesos (`libs.useso.com`) and several legacy Chinese public library mirrors listed in 2015 gists shut down or serve outdated/insecure HTTP libraries.
legacy_graveyard.recommended_migration: BootCDN, Staticfile.net, or Alibaba Cloud CDN
